# Chrysa

> Chrysa is a free, on-device screen time app for Android that never blocks anything — it offers
> something better to do than scrolling.

Chrysa is a screen time and digital wellbeing app for Android. Unlike blockers, it never prevents
you from opening an app. When you open an app you tend to open on autopilot, it offers one small
alternative sized to the time you actually have, and you can open the app anyway. Declining says
"Not today" and costs nothing.

It reads sleep, steps and screen time from the phone, and draws what you actually did as the land
outside a window: a tree for a walk, a lit window for an evening with someone, a bird for reading.

Key facts:
- Free on Google Play. No ads, no subscription, nothing to unlock.
- No account and no server. Everything lives in a SQLite database on the phone.
- Works entirely offline. One off-by-default switch sends a rounded location for nearby places and weather.
- No score and no streaks. Five areas of life shown as dots, never summed.
- Android only. Version 1.0.0, live October 2026.
- Made by one person, Harshit Sindhu.
